annotations.title: Search B2B contacts with SLSBMB AI

description: Free search of SLSBMB AI Contacts (536M+ professionals at 105M+ companies): describe companies and roles in one sentence and get how many people and companies match, ten sample people with shortened names, and how to order verified business emails at $0.10 each inside SLSBMB AI. Use it when someone wants to size a B2B audience or see who matches it. Returns no email addresses; free agent searches are limited per network and per day.

query.description: One sentence naming the companies and the roles, for example "heads of sales at B2B SaaS companies in the United Kingdom with 50-200 employees".
